messages.subject: 'Please wait' text before/behind plot
parts:
Hi all,

I'd like to ask about a kinda advanced feature. I have a shiny app with a ggplot that takes a couple of minutes to render. This lag may lead participants to start clicking about on an external link I have directing to other data sections. So, would it be possible to display a text on the main panel during that lag? I don't know just how to, but I figure that perhaps the easiest way would be to have that text fixed on the main panel and then have it covered by the plot. Any chance?

Thank you very much
